caveats: School assignment regions are approximate parcel-derived SLPS Focus lookup regions, not official boundary files.
School area comparisons are ACS resident estimates; assignment-region values are area-weighted Census tract overlaps and assume residents are uniformly distributed within each tract.
School metrics mix 2025 enrollment, PAR attendance proxy values, 2024-25 NCES counts, and Future Ready planning data.
PTO activity is curated public-evidence research, not an SLPS-maintained administrative field; unknown means not yet researched.
Missouri Assessment Program values describe MAP-tested students by content, grade, group, and metric; subgroup n_size values are not full-school enrollment counts.
MAP missing or suppressed percentage cells are omitted from charts, and reported missingness is displayed as its own assessment category.
School coordinates are geocoder-derived for source rows with addresses; rows without source addresses are omitted from the map.
City demographics are ACS estimates; home value is Zillow ZHVI typical home value, not an arithmetic average.
Public/private school enrollment layers are ACS residence-based estimates for ages 5-17 by Census geography, not SLPS-operated enrollment or school-site totals.

schools.map_2025_note: MAP assessment data uses tested-student denominators; subgroup n_size values are not full-school enrollment counts.

demographics_metadata.race_categories: Mutually exclusive B03002 categories. Other equals total minus non-Hispanic White alone and non-Hispanic Black alone, so it includes Hispanic residents and all other race groups.
demographics_metadata.school_enrollment_definition: Resident ages 5-17 enrolled in public or private school from ACS B14003. Public-school enrollment is not SLPS-operated enrollment and may include charter or other public-school enrollment captured by ACS.
demographics_metadata.school_enrollment_moe_note: Native ACS public/private school enrollment MOEs are root-sum-of-squares from component B14003 MOEs. Enrollment fields are left on the native Census geography rather than area-weighted to ZIPs.
demographics_metadata.zillow_label: Typical home value (ZHVI), not arithmetic average home value.
demographics_metadata.tornado_damage_note: NWS damage points are survey observations, not a complete parcel or building damage census.
demographics_metadata.zip_geometry_note: ZIP geometries are clipped to the St. Louis City boundary; ZHVI remains ZIP-level.
